system.name: Ferret
system.one_liner: An online continual learning framework that uses fine-grained pipeline parallelism, iterative gradient compensation and automated model partitioning to fit varying memory budgets.

content.variant_note: a runtime pipeline-parallel workflow (A) and a planner chain (B) feeding it, with three small schedule timelines for the design options at the right
content.argues: A planner picks the model partition and pipeline configuration for a memory budget, and many workers then train one model in parallel on streaming data while compensating stale gradients.
content.subject: N pipeline workers with forward, backward and update blocks over streaming batches, a gradient-compensation chain, the planner flow, and three schedule variants.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw parallel workers as translucent copies of one pipeline stacked in depth, and explain schedule options with tiny two-stage timelines whose cells are numbered by batch. A thick arrow carrying the planner's output into the runtime panel joins the two halves.
lessons.suits: Systems-style ML papers on parallel training, scheduling or memory planning that must show both a runtime pipeline and an offline planner.

evidence: Caption: in A, N workers are spawned from the optimal partition scheme and pipeline configuration and update the same model asynchronously.
Caption: in B, the optimal partition scheme and configuration are obtained by optimizing Eq. 2.
Methodology: the three timelines illustrate activation recomputation, gradient accumulation and backpropagation omission.

summary: Ferret is an online continual learning framework that keeps up with fast data streams under changing memory budgets. Figure 1 has two dashed components and three small timelines. In A, a pink band shows iterative gradient compensation, where batches and parameter versions pass through forward, backward and gradient boxes; below it N translucent worker layers hold streaming batches and rows of yellow forward and blue backward blocks with red update bars, all updating one Model. In B, a model profile and a memory constraint enter a planning box that outputs the optimal partition scheme and pipeline configuration, sent back to A by a thick arrow. Three two-stage timelines show recomputation, accumulation and backpropagation omission.
summary_zh: Ferret 是在变化内存预算下做在线持续学习的框架。图中A部分用粉色带表示迭代梯度补偿，下方是并行worker的前向、反向与更新块；B部分由模型画像和内存约束规划出最优划分与流水线配置；右侧三条时间线说明重计算、梯度累积和省略反向传播。
notes: The three timelines (a)-(c) are not joined to A or B by arrows; their link to the pipeline comes from the Methodology text (T1-T3). The bottom of the preview cuts off the caption and the start of another drawing, which were ignored.
